# Presentation fixture

`oxford-aster-human-semantic-v1.lync` contains the two privacy-safe OxfordAster
records from Behold's ratified presentation handoff. The event bodies are
unchanged; this copy adds the format's conventional terminal LF. Its SHA-256 is
`96daece15466ec53c8a992f3ea065a6b8b46b98594f7e3e819aa5217d2231bd5`.

It contains no local paths, credentials, raw provider payloads, or private
reasoning. Lync owns this copy only as a presentation conformance vector;
Behold remains authoritative for the resident profile's meaning.
